messages:
Clara Holt: FYI Mosaic onboarding flagged: p95 on /reply drifting to ~2.1s during their APAC peak and token usage ~38% above forecast. Traffic mix: lots of tiny conversational turns (~30-90 tokens) and occasional multi-paragraph summarizations. Thinking a tiered strategy: compact-int4 for short turns, standard for long-form, prefix KV cache for sessions, and a scheduled Dedicated window during APAC evening. Thoughts?

Diego Ramos: +1 on tiered routing. Do we have a reliable client-side signal to separate short turns from summaries? If not, we can fall back to sequence_length header.

Clara Holt: They can emit header.user_turn=true for interactive turns; we'll also add server-side seq_length check as backup.

Pri Patel: For renewal risk, present as a low-friction pilot: 48h canary on the compact path with a clear QA harness and cost/latency projection. I'll own the renewal slide and the savings calc.

Samir Khan: On the runtime side, prefer deterministic routing by token_count <= 120. Fallback cascade: compact-3b-int4 -> compact-3b-int8 -> standard-7b. Also recommend small prefix cache TTL (180s) and aggressive batching for compact path.

Clara Holt: Proposed rollout policy to hand to eng-runtime:
```json
{
  "route": "/reply",
  "selector": "header.user_turn == true || token_count <= 120",
  "primary_models": ["mosaic-compact-3b-int4", "mosaic-compact-3b-int8"],
  "fallback": "mosaic-standard-7b",
  "cache": {"prefix_kv": true, "ttl_seconds": 180},
  "dedicated_window": "15:00-22:00 Asia/Tokyo",
  "observability": ["latency_p95","token_burn_delta","regression_rate"]
}
```

Samir Khan: @eng-runtime-bot please schedule a 4% canary for 48h starting 2026-08-03T10:00:00Z. Required monitors: p95 latency, 5xx, token_burn_delta, and regression_rate against Pri's QA set with a 7% tolerance. Add automatic rollback if p95 increases >10% or regression_rate >7% sustained for 15m.

eng-runtime-bot: Canary job scheduled: job_id=mosaic-canary-812999-01, start=2026-08-03T10:00:00Z, traffic=4%, duration=48h. Monitoring hooks configured. Will post periodic reports. :gear: 

Pri Patel: I'll publish a 25-case QA harness focused on tone, entity preservation, and summary fidelity. Quality gate: <=7% failures and no high-severity hallucinations. Will run evaluation immediately after the canary and post results here.

Diego Ramos: I'll prepare a short A/B slice to capture perceived latency improvements and token delta on actual traffic. Also drafting a patch to client SDK to add header.user_turn as recommended.

Clara Holt: Great. I'll update the renewal tracker (status: pilot-scheduled) and sync with the account lead to set expectations. Plan an enablement 20-min session for Mosaic PMs after we have canary outputs.

ops-bot: Reminder created: CS follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-08-06T15:00:00Z.

Samir Khan: If canary is green, we'll ramp 4% -> 20% -> 60% over 72h with rollout gates. If we see token_burn_delta improvements and stable quality, that will be our recommended path in the renewal SOW.

Pri Patel: Noted. I'll draft the renewal note and slide with three scenarios (conservative/expected/optimistic savings) and share before the canary start.

Clara Holt: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for results and next steps. :rocket:
